title: Parabolic rectifiability of the Brakke flow
summary: We prove that the support of the canonical space-time measure for a Brakke flow is a parabolic $(k+2)$-rectifiable set. As a consequence, we obtain that at almost all points along the flow, with respect to this canonical space-time measure, there exists a unique, static, planar tangent flow, and that various notions of density for the flow agree at these points. Moreover, following on from our previous work `The space-time-Grassmann measure of the Brakke flow', we continue to develop the approach to the Brakke flow as a space-time-Grassmann measure.
